body:
I'll start by surveying the current state of my four files and the reference style.

Done — four files revised and verified.

| File | Bytes | Target |
|---|---:|---|
| `00-index.md` | 6,261 | ✓ 6,200–7,200 |
| `01-product-and-license.md` | 6,706 | ✓ |
| `02-architecture-and-processes.md` | 7,185 | ✓ |
| `03-source-and-build.md` | 7,154 | ✓ |

Checks I ran: `wc -c`; `grep -c '^## Sources'` = 1 in each file and `## Sources` is the last heading (verified by listing all `^## ` headings); every `path:line` range resolved under `/tmp/litellm-src` by a script that parsed each backticked citation and compared the max line against the file's line count (0 failures after fixes; the only remaining "hits" are `config.yaml` — a user file — and `schema.prisma`, a bare filename in a table cell, neither being `path:line`). I spot-read every cited range I kept for semantic match (entrypoint components, lifespan steps, middleware, auth, route_checks gate, Dockerfile stages, compose/Helm/Chart, pyproject sections) and re-measured every count (3,580 / 1,158,033 / 460,585 / 159 / 254 / 87 / 5,921 / 6,237 / 9,517 / 3,990,253 / 34 MB).

Structural edits: merged the two boundary tables in `01` into one Community/Enterprise matrix; merged `00`'s "load when" + scope paragraphs; turned `02`'s startup-order list into a Step/Evidence table and its spend knobs table into prose; turned `03`'s Docker bullet list into a table and dropped the duplicated `find` command block.

Fixes found while verifying:
- Enterprise license line is `litellm/enterprise/pyproject.toml:7` (was cited as `:5` in `00`/`01`). Note: `SKILL.md` also says `:5` — out of my scope, left untouched.
- Enterprise license nuance corrected: dev/test copying allowed (`:19-21`), production needs a subscription (`:7-12`), resale/sublicensing forbidden (`:23-25`), replacing the imprecise "forbids copying" claim.

Factual precision kept per file: scope/license/decisions (`01`), 9-step boot order + 5-stage request path + state placement + worker/scheduler semantics (`02`), measured surface + packaging/extras/build stages/pinning (`03`).

Deliberately dropped (all redundant, not unique facts): the three docs URLs from `00` Sources that were never cited inline (`configs.md`, `redis_requirements.md`); `LICENSE:1-10` in favor of `:1-4`; the flattened `4000/tcp 4001/tcp 3000/tcp` spelling in `02` (ports remain in the component table, `Dockerfile:218` still cited); `litellm/runtime/backend/main.py` as a standalone Sources bullet in `02` (still cited inline in the component table); the repeated Enterprise feature enumeration in `02` §7 (points to `01`'s matrix); per-provider example paths in `03` reduced to one example; `litellm/llms/`, `litellm/rust/crates/` and the migrations path as Sources bullets in `03` (paths still appear inline).

Not run, as instructed: the global verifier (siblings are still editing).
